bullets.text: Working with the CTO and our team of ~30 Employees, We continued to improve existing features & rollout new features for our end users. Overhauled the majority of our internal data management interfaces to improve the experience of our Employees, and reduce company cost on admin time.

Overhauled our internal data management interfaces and streamlined many avenues of searching, creating, and analyzing data. Saved the company ~9000 in increased software subscription price, and ~2% of overall budget expenditures previously spent on employee admin time.
Assisted the CTO with building robust, maintainable features to improve the experience of our internal tools and customer facing products
Reduced known bugs in production by 98% (400/wk to >10/wk)
Lead a project to convert entire SPA React app to Typescript
Implemented testing for the first time in our CI/CD pipeline, giving the team more confidence when pushing code to production
As our team's sole Front-End Developer, I created our design on Figma and implemented it using Javascript, CSS, and Jinja2, an HTML templating engine for Python Back-End applications.
Quantified Techlahoma's impact on who they serve to streamline the process of grant applications.
Introduced a unique incentives program, rewarding attendees with points for check-ins, redeemable for discounted or free Techlahoma conference tickets.
Implemented a call-to-action feature for users to earn additional points by providing optional information like zip code, phone number, and Linkedin profile URL.
Integrated seamlessly with Techlahoma’s existing Nonprofit CRM, NeonCRM, utilizing its REST API for data management and user authentication.
Solely developed a mobile application intended for Android and iOS using the Dart programming language and Flutter Software Development Kit.

Integrated Firebase services including real-time database, cloud storage, and authentication by implementing custom models for user data, prioritizing efficient data management and reliable authentication processes.
Followed design specs from Figma user interface files, transmuting static layouts into a dynamic mobile application.
Demonstrated strong collaboration and technical expertise by efficiently managing data transfer between different sections of the website, namely the back-end server/API and front-end quiz logic.
